Protocol 49: everyone needs 0.9.0
Friends with different mods, or the same mods in another order, can play together
Give each other items by dropping them; whoever takes it first gets it
Host controls in the F1 menu: kick, ban, lock the session, password
Much smoother movement for friends, adapting to the connection
F8 pings what you aim at, with a ring on everyone's compass
Shared radiant quests for the Minutemen, Brotherhood, Institute, Railroad and Diamond City posters
Looted chests and corpses, and picked plants, are shared
Host-tuned revives (bleed-out time, revives per fight, cooldown), VATS in real time, tutorial hints off
Shared security gates, settlement power and building, and objects moved or knocked over
A friend in power armor walks in it; a downed friend lies down until helped up
Fixed: the black screen on joining, a crash on saving next to a friend, quickloads restarting the session with mods installed, damage not counting after a reload
Full notes on GitHub
